limitations: UNVERIFIED: the mapping of PD study-definition Conditions A/B/C to strains (A = D39 wild type [flagged Control in the .msf], B = Delta3UTR, C = Delta3UTR CEP:3UTR) is inferred from the strain order in the paper's Methods; the deposit, the paper text and its supplement (Supplementary_file docx, Tables S1/S2) contain no channel table. A B/C swap would invert genotype for 6 of 9 samples (factor value[genotype]).
Only the first ~75 MB of the 11 GB .msf was read; Mascot node parameters not verified.
Condition letter to strain mapping is inferred, not stated.
Lys-C predigest not representable (single-valued cleavage column).
RAW headers not inspected; instrument from PRIDE/paper.
